headline: Get Paid 10% To Cap Your DIS Stock At 8.1% Higher
summary: For Walt Disney shareholders, here is a way to get paid a meaningful income now, money you keep no matter what, in exchange for agreeing to sell your stock at a higher price if it gets there.
